top_signals.title: Shenzhen’s Manufacturing Power Draws Wave of Innovators
top_signals.summary:
You can't get the speed anywhere else": Despite tariffs and political narratives, hardware innovators from the US are rushing back to China's tech capital to turn their ideas into reality faster and cheaper. Bloomberg's Stephen Engle has more.
(Corrects guest’s job title in on-screen graphic at 1:47.) (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Mitsui & Co. Said to Back J-Oil Mills in Battle Over Kadoya
top_signals.summary: Kadoya Sesame Mills Inc. shareholder Mitsui & Co. has backed a proposal from J-Oil Mills Inc. to take over the Japanese sesame seed oil seller, according to people familiar with the matter, potentially strengthening the bidder’s hand in a three-way battle for control of the company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
